sentences.en: Which do you like better, fiction or non-fiction?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢小说还是非虚构作品？

sentences.en: Is that really your favorite book? I didn't know you liked non-fiction...
sentences.zh: 那真的是你的最爱的书吗？我还以为你不爱看非虚构作品呢……

sentences.en: I don't often read non-fiction books.
sentences.zh: 我不常读非虚构类书籍。
